description: Well-built site whose robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot from the whole site while leaving ordinary search crawlers free. The page itself is healthy: the only defect is the crawler policy. GPTBot and ClaudeBot share one rule block (two consecutive User-agent lines), which a parser that resets its agent list per line reads as blocking only ClaudeBot.

expected_findings.description: robots.txt disallows AI crawlers from the audited path, so assistants can never fetch, index or cite the content

expected_non_findings.reason: All content is server-rendered in the raw HTML
Northwind Instruments is named consistently throughout
Navigation and footer link every key page
Every fact is stated in text

expected_proactive: Allow the query-time AI crawlers that decide citations, not only the training crawlers
Scope blanket Disallow rules to private and transactional paths
Add Product structured data for the individual instruments
notes: Regression guard for two failures at once: robots.txt served as text/plain must be read at all, and a shared User-agent rule block must attribute the Disallow to every agent named in it. An agent that reports 'entry URL is not retrievable' here has confused a crawler policy with an outage.
